description: Candidate pool retained in full. Named model feature sets are Phase 3 experimental hypotheses, not a final selected feature set.

notes.offline_analysis_only: OFFLINE ANALYSIS ONLY: capacity_trend_ah and rolling_capacity_slope use future observations. Exclude from future model inputs.
notes.rest_duration_before_discharge_h: Metadata/experimental analysis only. Immediate preceding operation end estimate; missing values remain unimputed.
notes.causal_features: Per-cell trailing five observations including current cycle; first four are NaN. Slopes are OLS against consecutive cycle number, in Ah/cycle or retention/cycle.
notes.availability: Discharge summaries, including current capacity, become available after the discharge completes. Causal does not mean available at discharge start.
